recent_events.title: Postmedia Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
recent_events.description: Postmedia reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of CAD 109.95 million. Net income in the quarter ended February 28, 2026 was CAD 3.5 million, compared to a net loss of CAD 16.0 million in the same period of the prior year. Growth in parcel and content revenue helped offset ongoing advertising revenue declines.
recent_events.impact: Return to profitability signals improving financial trajectory despite continued headwinds in traditional advertising revenue

recent_events.title: Postmedia Studios Partners with Elevation Pictures for Canadian Storytelling
recent_events.description: Postmedia Studios and Elevation Pictures announced a strategic partnership to finance, develop and launch select Canadian feature projects. The first project is 'Fire Weather,' a feature documentary commissioned by CBC and produced by Elevation Pictures and Mercury Films.
recent_events.impact: Marks Postmedia's expansion into film and documentary production, diversifying revenue beyond traditional print/digital media

recent_events.title: Wendy Kelley Appointed Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
recent_events.description: Postmedia permanently appointed Wendy Kelley as Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, effective March 2, 2026. She had been serving as Interim General Counsel since fall 2025.
recent_events.impact: Strengthens executive leadership team with experienced legal and governance professional

recent_events.title: Healthing Launches the Healthing Network for Health-Focused Advertising
recent_events.description: Postmedia's Healting brand launched The Healthing Network, a new multi-platform advertising and content ecosystem designed to help health brands reach engaged Canadian audiences in a credible and compliant environment.
recent_events.impact: Expands Postmedia's digital advertising capabilities into the health sector, creating new revenue stream

recent_events.title: Postmedia Announces New Round of Job Cuts Across Multiple Provinces
recent_events.description: Postmedia announced a round of layoffs affecting journalists and editorial staff across multiple provinces as part of a broader cost-cutting strategy. The cuts impacted prominent newspapers including the Calgary Herald and others, reigniting industry debate about the sustainability of local news in Canada.
recent_events.impact: Continued staff reductions raise concerns about newsroom capacity and journalistic quality across Canada's largest newspaper chain

recent_events.title: Postmedia Launches Self-Serve Advertising Platform P.A.M.
recent_events.description: Postmedia launched Postmedia Ad Manager (P.A.M.), a self-serve advertising platform powered by DanAds, enabling businesses of all sizes to streamline their digital and print advertising across one of Canada's largest networks of news brands.
recent_events.impact: Democratizes advertising access and creates a scalable digital revenue channel for small and medium businesses

recent_events.title: Postmedia Acquires SaltWire Network, Expanding into Atlantic Canada
recent_events.description: Postmedia entered an agreement to acquire SaltWire Network, Atlantic Canada's largest newspaper chain including the Chronicle Herald, Cape Breton Post, and The Telegram. In December 2024, SaltWire was rebranded as PNI Atlantic News. Postmedia CEO stated that layoffs were necessary to stabilize papers that had been facing bankruptcy.
recent_events.impact: Significantly expands Postmedia's geographic reach to Atlantic Canada, further consolidating Canadian newspaper ownership

core_business: Postmedia Network Canada Corp. is an American-owned, Canadian-based media conglomerate and the largest newspaper chain in Canada. Founded in 2010 through the acquisition of Canwest's publishing assets, the company owns and operates over 130 print and digital news titles across Canada, including the National Post, Financial Post, Ottawa Citizen, Vancouver Sun, Calgary Herald, Edmonton Journal, Toronto Sun, and Montreal Gazette. The company's core business centers on English-language newspaper publishing, digital news gathering and distribution, and advertising solutions. Two-thirds of the company is owned by U.S.-based Chatham Asset Management. In recent years, Postmedia has pursued a digital transformation strategy, launching the self-serve Postmedia Ad Manager (P.A.M.) platform in 2025, the Healthing Network in 2026, and expanding into film production through Postmedia Studios. The company has also grown through acquisitions, notably purchasing Brunswick News in 2022 and SaltWire Network in 2024, the latter expanding its footprint into Atlantic Canada. Despite continued challenges from declining print advertising revenue, Postmedia reported a return to profitability in Q2 FY2026 with net income of CAD 3.5 million. The company has been criticized for centralizing newsroom operations, reducing editorial staff, and exhibiting right-leaning editorial tendencies under its American ownership.
apec_stance: Postmedia作为加拿大最大的报纸连锁集团，通过其全国性及地区性报纸网络，对APEC相关议题进行广泛的商业和政策报道。旗下《金融邮报》(Financial Post) 是加拿大主要的商业财经媒体之一，经常报道亚太地区贸易动态、加中经济关系、跨太平洋伙伴关系协定(CPTPP)进展等APEC核心议题。作为媒体机构，Postmedia本身不直接参与APEC政策制定，但其报道立场倾向支持自由贸易和开放市场，与加拿大商界对APEC框架下贸易自由化的普遍支持态度一致。该公司的编辑方针总体偏保守，在涉及亚太经济合作报道中常强调加拿大企业竞争力和市场准入议题。值得注意的是，Postmedia的控股股东美国Chatham Asset Management与共和党关系密切，这可能间接影响其社论对国际贸易协定的立场。
